correctness.rationale: The quotient-rule derivation is exact. For delta=beta_n-beta_p>0 and the published influence functions, the composition sign reduces to F_S(I)=delta I^2+[delta k+S(2 omega_0-c)]I-Sck. This polynomial is strictly increasing on I>=0, is negative at zero, and is positive at I_cross because Delta omega(I_cross)=0, proving the unique-root formula and 0<I_comp(S)<I_cross. Exact rational arithmetic verifies the default-parameter witness.
